run: just e2e builds the wasm and the server, then runs the Playwright tests in e2e/ (just e2e tests/<name>.spec.ts for one spec); to look at the app by hand, run just build then just serve and open http://127.0.0.1:8137/ (E2E_PORT moves the port).
evidence: Run the spec that covers the change with just e2e tests/<name>.spec.ts and attach its screenshots and traces (the failing-then-passing run); for a server or logic change attach the cargo test output for the new tests.
